description:
Is this alternative-data signal real for these tickers - or noise?

Explained PIT significance per underlying from the release-gated
pit_analysis/v2 run: each (dataset|metric|horizon) family reports rolling
52-week IR, Newey-West two-sided p, observation count, research-only and
staleness flags, and an explicit verdict - SIGNIFICANT (survives the run's
IR > 0 and BH q <= 0.05 gate), NOT_SIGNIFICANT, below the observation floor,
or UNVERIFIED. Point-in-time, derived-only, no raw values; free lite answers,
Pro gives every family. Not investment advice.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD, default today): release points after this date are ignored.
as_of.title: As Of

horizons.description: Subset of the run's horizons, e.g. ['1d','1w','1m','6m'] (default: all).
horizons.title: Horizons

max_families.description: Max families returned per underlying, most significant first (1-100).
max_families.title: Max Families

only_significant.description: Only return families with at least one SIGNIFICANT horizon (counts still cover everything).
only_significant.title: Only Significant

symbols.description: Underlying tickers to query (max 10). Results are per underlying.
symbols.title: Symbols
